## The Degradation Equation {#sec-notation-conventions-degradation-equation-ad12 .unlisted}

The degradation equation is a fitted local model. Divergence alone does not determine the direction of accuracy change, so estimate $\lambda$ from labeled outcomes. Some symbols below, such as $\tau$, appear in chapter prose rather than in the equation.
$$\AccuracyAtTime \approx \InitialAccuracyZero - \lambda \cdot \StatisticalDivergence$$
